cards.front: Recall a key point about Networks and Internet
cards.back: Topologies: Star (central hub), Mesh (all connected), Bus (shared cable), Ring (token passing)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Networks and Internet
cards.back: TCP/IP: App (HTTP, DNS, FTP), Transport (TCP reliable, UDP fast), Internet (IP routing), Link (Ethernet, WiFi)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Networks and Internet
cards.back: TCP: 3-way handshake, sequencing, flow control, congestion control; UDP: connectionless, low latency

cards.front: Recall a key point about Networks and Internet
cards.back: DNS: hierarchical (root, TLD, authoritative); recursive/iterative queries; records (A, AAAA, MX, CNAME)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Networks and Internet
cards.back: IPv4: 32-bit, dotted decimal, classes A/B/C, subnet mask, CIDR (/24); IPv6: 128-bit, hex, no NAT needed

cards.front: Recall a key point about Networks and Internet
cards.back: Threats: malware (virus, worm, ransomware), phishing, DoS/DDoS, MITM, SQLi (input sanitisation), XSS (output encoding)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Networks and Internet
cards.back: Encryption: Symmetric (AES, same key), Asymmetric (RSA, public/private); TLS: handshake, certificates, CA; Firewall: packet filter, stateful, application; VPN: encrypted tunnel; Auth: MFA, OAuth, JWT
